title: Power Apps: consolidated AI settings for model-driven apps in Maker Studio and Copilot hub
summary: Hold: three controls tell administrators that automation is not documented, although Microsoft's environment-management API documents the corresponding Power Apps AI fields and an update operation. The roadmap facts, current admin paths and underlying skills' licence requirements are supported.
